title: Loss Mitigation — Final Mod & Closing
subtitle: 5 modifications in final underwriting / recording

kpis.label: In closing
kpis.helper: Permanent modifications in final QC and county recording.

kpis.label: Recording
kpis.helper: Modification has been sent to and accepted by the county recorder.

kpis.label: Signed Off
kpis.helper: Final QC passed. Documents go to the county for recording.

kpis.label: Sign Off & In Progress
kpis.helper: At least one item on the final QC checklist is still pending (e.g., title endorsement).

kpis.label: Denied
kpis.helper: QC failed, or the trial broke. Modification will not be recorded; loan returns to Eligibility or a non-retention path.

kpis.label: In Human Review
kpis.helper: Loans where a closer is actively reviewing — typically because the recording SLA has slipped or QC needs senior sign-off.
